name: rumbo
description: Keep agreed work connected to its artifacts, evidence and human decisions.

interface.shortDescription: Keep work on its agreed course
interface.longDescription: Inspect the agreed goal and constraints, claim bounded tasks, register exact artifact revisions, run deterministic acceptance checks and request human decisions. The project board separates work claims, narrow check receipts, reviewer assertions and human acceptance. Rumbo does not grant authority, run arbitrary commands, or prove that every requirement is correct.
defaultPrompt: What evidence is missing before acceptance?
Which work became stale after the last change?

publication.release_notes: 0.3.5 local review candidate: bundles shared engine 0.3.4 and preserves the prior diagnostics, storage and registry improvements. The board ignores superseded project-selection, refresh and delayed initial host results. Mutations add optional response_mode=receipt and keep full snapshots by default; tools/list schemas are larger even without opt-in. Receipts are incomplete operation-time observations and include a full-state recovery call. Owner-provisioned aliases and worker-only authority are unchanged. Actual host installation and reviewer connection remain separate verification gates. Rebuilt task-detail controls retain useful keyboard focus without stale clipboard feedback. Prepared distribution identity only; no release or installed update is claimed.
